abstract: The great majority of teratomas of the head and neck present in the neonate or infant and are biologically benign and yet with a high mortality because of their space-occupying and obstructive character. Teratomas in the adult neck and sinonasal tract are histologically and biologically malignant, with an often unpredictable response to therapy.
abstract_ja: 頭頸部の奇形腫の大多数は新生児や乳児に生じ、生物学的には良性です。しかし、占拠性・閉塞性の性質のため死亡率は高いです。成人の頸部および副鼻腔の奇形腫は、組織学的にも生物学的にも悪性で、治療への反応が予測しにくいものです。
